messages:
ops-bot: ALERT hosted-usw2-gpu-pool: admission_reject_rate p95 >= 15% over 2m. Dash: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/4XgF/gpu-pool-overview?orgId=1&from=now-15m
maria: seeing it too — p95 queue time spike to 3.1s, but node GPU utilization low in az-b/c? odd
jake: pool AZ breakdown: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/azs/hosted-usw2-pool-azs?from=now-30m — most queued in az-a
adrian: looks like az-a has most queued requests, az-b/c show free GPUs but requests are sticky to az-a due to soft-affinity
maria: yep, admission controller still honoring zone affinity and we added per-AZ min_reserved tokens in last config roll
tanvi: could the token-bucket refill math be wrong after the rollout? I remember a recent change to burst token window handling
lee: quick check on metrics: token_refill_rate for az-a = 0.0 while az-b/c show normal refills
maria: repro query I ran:
```sql
select zone, sum(refill_rate) from admission_metrics where pool='hosted-usw2' group by zone;
```
ops-bot: incident note: detection started at 1985001234
adrian: hypothesis: refill calculation uses integer division when instance_type_scale > 1, zeroing small refills for certain instance mixes in az-a
jake: immediate mitigation: lower soft-affinity weight to let requests spread cross-AZ. Patch command:
```bash
curl -XPOST https://control-plane/api/v1/pools/hosted-usw2/patch -d '{"soft_affinity_weight":0.2}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $SVC_TOKEN"
```
maria: applied patch -> routing is evening out, queue p95 dropping to ~1.1s now
tanvi: we need a hotfix for admission-service and a canary deploy to verify refill logic
lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/admission-service/pull/421 — fixes integer division and adds unit tests
adrian: action items: 1) deploy hotfix canary to us-west-2 (adrian) 2) run pool rebalance job in 30m (jake) 3) add unit test for token refill edge-case (tanvi) 4) postmortem if rollout caused this (maria)
jake: note on costs/limits: temporary cross-AZ routing will increase egress and may expose SNAT exhaustion — watch egress_snat_used and customer-egress-errors
ops-bot: created incident ticket IN-2026 and paged on-call
maria: staying on for next 45m to watch stabilization. thanks all :thumbsup:
